spans.text: Night falls over the beach as the voting finally comes to an end.
K-PDW takes the MVP slot through the number of Seals of the Wolfpack accumulated.
...On the night of the voting.
Near a certain stall, right before the final results are revealed.
And then? What did you see?
Five-Seven leans forward unconsciously, trying to get a better view.
Although the Commander tried their best to hide it, I managed to see it...
The last name that the Commander wrote on the Seal of the Wolfpack was—
K-PDW?
Mhm~
Five-Seven deflates and collapses into her chair.
...And here I thought the Commander would reward my hard work with a vote.
Look on the bright side. At least K-PDW is one of the Werewolves.
If she wins, it's good news for us too, no?
"Good news"? I don't think so.
A pair of nimble hands whisk away the empty glasses and replace them with fresh drinks.
Thank you, Miss Gr G36~
However, it's not good to eavesdrop on your customers' conversation, no?
I just happened to hear you mention the possibility that K-PDW might win.
Pardon my rudeness, but I believe a Doll who rigs the votes and whose reputation is in tatters will cause massive headaches for her side, even if she scores a victory for them.
...Are you complaining to us, as members of the Werewolves?
Are you feeling resentful because K-PDW killed you in the game of Lycan Sanctuary?
It's just a game. I'm not so narrow-minded that I'd want to take revenge on her. Not yet, at least.
Then that's the end of that, isn't it? It's just a game, after all.
The vote tonight is also a game, so what's wrong with the Werewolves using the scheming and trickery that they're familiar with?
It's clearly an effective winning strategy...
Beepbeep.
Just then, everyone's communicators ring in unison.
Ahem! Good evening, everyone!
The prize presentation for "Lycan Sanctuary" will begin in five minutes. Please proceed to the podium immediately!
I repeat...
Shall we, my dear Leader Five-Seven?
Alright. I can't wait to see the final result...
See you later, Miss Gr G36~
Five-Seven smiles smugly and leisurely departs with DP-12 in tow.
...At the prize presentation.
K-PDW isn't here yet... What should we do, Commander?
It's alright, let's just begin.
It might be better if she doesn't come...
After hiding their thoughts on the matter, the Commander purses their lips and steps up onto the empty prize presentation podium.
The White Lycan King glares at them from the audience, her gaze both searching and expectant. The Commander nervously clears their throat.
I declare that the MVP of this round of Lycan Sanctuary is—
K-PDW.
There is no applause or cheering. The audience is dead silent.
Ah... I believe everyone knows K-PDW is a Werewolf.
However, my vote for her was not to support the Werewolves' victory, but to use this as an opportunity to apologize to everyone on K-PDW's behalf...
At the edge of the crowd, Gr G36 nods at the Commander.
The Commander smiles in gratitude and raises the mike again.
There will be a sumptuous dinner banquet waiting for everyone after the prize presentation ceremony.
K-PDW and I would like everyone, be they Werewolves or Villagers, to forget any unpleasantness in the game and have a good time on this island...
Honeyyyy~ Here~ I~ Come~
A fiendish voice suddenly speaks from behind the Commander!
There is a mighty gust of wind, and as the Commander spins on one heel—
Smack!
H-honey...
The prize plaque that the Commander is holding hits K-PDW square in the face, distorting her happy smile.
I, uh, I'm sorry, K-PDW.
The Commander pulls back, then slips the plaque into K-PDW's arms.
Thank you, honey~ I knew you loved me best after all~
Oh yes, what were you saying just now? I think I heard something about a "sumptuous dinner banquet" and "having a good time", no?
Did you prepare a personal, private reward just for me?!
Er... Listen to me, K-PDW.
The banquet is only meaningful when it's shared with everyone, just like how a game needs to be played with everyone, isn't that right?
After all, winning isn't as important as the friends we make along the way...
Haaaaah?! But I'M the MVP! How can you expect me to have dinner as equals with all those inferior stupid trash?!
They ought to be kowtowing in front of me, serving up refreshments and snacks, massaging my back and making me feel all over... That's the treatment they deserve!
What?!
Wait a minute, who are you calling "inferior stupid trash"? We're your teammates!
Heh.
Whum—
As angry shouts fill the air, K-PDW grabs a mike.
"Teammates"? What are those?
I was the one who brought victory to the Werewolves! What does that have to do with any of you trash?!
A most sudden but inevitable betrayal indeed.
This is bullshit!!!
As Five-Seven bellows in rage, the Dolls in the audience begin to stir—
Yeah, this is bullshit! She was already pissing me off ever since we began setting up the stalls!
Core her and beat her up!!!
I have grenades! Let's get her!
Calm down! Everyone, calm down!
The Commander doesn't bother trying to snatch the mike back. Instead they stand in front of everyone and shout out loud—
Don't take K-PDW's words to heart!
The prize presentation is over! Dismissed! Everyone is dismissed!!!
Bweeehhh... Why are you speaking up for them, honey?! It's their fault for being sore loser trash—
That's enough out of you, K-PDW!
Who were you calling a sore loser? I'll rub you out right now, see if I don't!
Everyone, put your guns down. Stop messing around.
The feedback screech from a huge megaphone fills the air.
The Commander feels like they've been granted a stay of execution and whirls around, sweat dripping down their back—Gr G36 is standing at the head of the crowd with a stern look on her face.
Whew... Thank God.
Commander, colleagues.
Gr G36 quietly bows.
As the manager of tonight's banquet, may I suggest a compromise solution?
Miss Gr G36 has never been biased! Go on and say it!
All eyes turn to Gr G36.
She glances at K-PDW, who's hiding behind the Commander, and takes a deep breath.
My solution is—
We should give K-PDW what she wants and give her a personal banquet.
...Say what?!
Miss Gr G36!!!
Faced with this fresh storm of controversy, Gr G36 simply turns around without saying a word...
In response, everyone exchanges looks, and their doubts finally subside.
No, K-PDW's suggestion is too absurd, I can't—
Please let me handle it, Commander.
The Commander looks like they still want to keep speaking, but the determined look in Gr G36's eyes stops them.
...Very well, it seems you agree too.
Now then, Miss K-PDW...
WIll you permit me to invite you to a banquet of unprecedented opulence?
K-PDW unconsciously gulps as she takes in Gr G36's formal, respectful invitation.
Ahem! Don't think you can get one over me just with some run-of-the-mill snacks!
I have high standards! I want the bestest and most decadent top quality service and the most obedient and humble servants... Can you do that?
It shall be as you wish, Miss K-PDW.
Heh... Hehe...
K-PDW loosens her grip on the Commander's coat. She lowers her head and bursts into maniacal laughter.
Did you see that? Even Gr G36 accepts that I'm the great MVP!!!
You will ALL listen to me! Make sure you serve me well afterwards! Got that, you stupid trash?!
Hehehe... Ahahahaha!
It is nighttime, aboard a luxurious cruise liner. The waters are calm and there is no wind.
The air conditioner gently blows over cool and slightly salty air, while brilliant, sparkling waves ripple across the surface of the indoor pool.
To serve Miss K-PDW is a supreme honor for every member of this vessel's crew...
Pfhaaaah—!
This grape slushie is great! Give me another!
...Very well.
Gr G36 takes the glass that K-PDW just emptied, then retreats to the side to fill it up again.
Is this hard enough, o noble Miss K-PDW?
Five-Seven swallows her anger and adjusts her wrists to massage K-PDW's shoulders from a different angle.
Mediocre, really.
(Sigh) I guess there's no comparing a clumsy Doll like you to a professional masseuse.
Miss K-PDW, open wide and say "ahhhh"—
Ahhhh—
A peeled rose grape lands on K-PDW's tongue.
A tart sweetness spreads through her mouth and she squeezes her eyes shut in delight.
Ah~
This is divine! Mmmmmm~!
The VVIP on the reclining chair rolls over in satisfaction.
Miss K-PDW~
DP-12 moves away with perfect timing, her attitude gentle and humble.
Forgive me for having no applicable skills to serve you with...
Would you care to listen to a folk tale or two to ease your boredom?
K-PDW yawns lazily.
Eh, go ahead.
Alright~
DP-12 pages through the book she's holding.
Long before your time, in the southern province of—
Stop.
This is such a cliched beginning, it's totally boring! Start with another.
Understood~
The pages of DP-12's book flip again.
Oh ignorant descendants, do you still remember the dark and distant legend that took place in the Lycan Sanctuary?
Everything stemmed from a humble little covenant...
One made between the villagers and the God of Lycan...
Hmmm~ Now that's more like it~
K-PDW sits up and pricks up her ears.
The covenant decreed that on every full moon, at the Lycan's killing hour, all villagers and Lycans would have to play a cruel game—
If the villagers won, the God of Lycan would make a concession and grant them all a peaceful night...
But if the Lycans won, the vicious God of Lycan would descend and slaughter everyone...
DP-12 suddenly stops, then turns to smile at K-PDW.
And it seems there's a full moon tonight, my dear Miss K-PDW~
Do you think our game will draw the attention of he God of Lycan?
Do you think we've accidentally called down a terrible doom upon ourselves?
K-PDW can't help rolling her eyes.
Ah! Please don't move, Miss K-PDW! There's still one more slice of cucumber left~
Hehe, all done! Now your face is moister than a grape. Behold—
K-PDW pouts and takes the mirror Gr G28 offers without a second thought.
Those old folk tales are the kind used to scare stupid kids.
Well, I'm not scared, I don't—
Whoosh!
A shadow suddenly flashes past in the mirror!
Who's that?!
K-PDW goes pale and she jumps up from her chair.
Hey, did you see that just now? Was there something behind me?!
Hm? Nope...
I didn't see anything.
I guess someone walked past?
Ooooo... OoooooOOoooo...
The faint sound of sobbing makes its way over from the distance.
H-hey, you guys, listen! Someone's crying!
Click. Gr G36 switches off the virtual projector inside the tent.
It seems the projector system malfunctioned. I apologize if this has spoiled your experience...
K-PDW nervously grips the handrests of her chair.
Oooooh...
OoooooOOoooo...
Wait a minute... Why's the sound of sobbing still there?!
The white fabric inside the windless tent sways gently, like the shroud of a ghost...
And K-PDW's hair stands on end.
H-Hey, go see what it is! Someone! Anyone!!!
Understood.
Gr G36 bows. Then, she pulls the tent flap out of the way and heads outside.
Gr G28's palm presses lightly on K-PDW's hand and gently consoles her.
Relax, Miss K-PDW, everyone's working outside the tent. I'm sure there won't be any horrible monsters who will barge their way in...
Whoosh. The entrance flap opens again.
I've checked the surroundings, Miss K-PDW—
Wait a minute, who said that?!
K-PDW nervously looks toward the doorway.
There is nobody there.
It's me, Gr G36... What's the matter?
W-Where are you, Gr G36?!
Hey, do you see her?
K-PDW's hand shakes uncontrollably.
Huh? Are you talking to me?
What are you talking about? Miss Gr G36 is standing right there, isn't she?
Yeah, she's right in front of us, pretty face and all...
A thrill of fear runs through K-PDW's heart.
D-Don't move, all of you!
Gr G36, pick up the candle on the table!
The sound of footsteps approaches and the air currents in the tent shift.
The candlelight flickers and the yellow-blue flame rises into the air as the candlestick below it is lifted up.
Will this do, Miss K-PDW?
But there is still nothing beyond the candle flame. K-PDW rubs her eyes vigorously.
What's the matter, Miss K-PDW?
You... All of you, put down what you're holding and stand besides Gr G36! Stand in a row!
Hurry up!!!
The Dolls inside the room exchange looks and stand together in front of the entrance flap.
The inside of the tent is terrifyingly silent save for the rustling of fabric.
It... comes...
Crackle! The light bulbs flicker and the three people before K-PDW freeze in place.
Creak, creeeaak—
Five-Seven's head slowly, spookily turns a full 180 degrees, and then she... smiles.
The God of Lycan comes...
The God of Lycan comes...
Drip, drip. Drops of warm, crimson liquid splash on K-PDW's shoulder.
Startled, K-PDW jerks her head up—
There are huge crimson words on the canopy, and they look like they've been freshly painted there...
HERE I COME!
AAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHH—
Bang!
KAC?
KAC??
Ahhhh— Save me, honey!
There, there, don't be scared...
You're awake, you've woken up and everything is alright!
...Huh?
K-PDW bolts upright, and then her racing heart calms down a little—
The dazzling spotlight hits her in the face and the mic stand remains where it is.
Over a dozen faces are looking at her from the audience... Now where has she seen them before?
Do you remember what happened, K-PDW?
K-PDW is briefly confused and blankly shakes her head.
...I was just about to give you the prize plaque, but then you accidentally bumped your head into it and you fainted!
Hah? I...
Yeah! You were out for a full minute!
DP-12 and I nearly bluescreened from panic! We almost opened fire on the Villagers!
As K-PDW looks at Five-Seven's face, she remembers the creepy way the latter's turned a full 180 degrees backward and averts her eyes in fear.
Look, the moon is blood-red tonight... That's not a good sign, don't you think?
Aiiieeeee!
Commander, I've performed a scan of Miss K-PDW's components. No issues detected.
The reason for her unconsciousness is unclear. I recommend returning to base and performing a more in-depth examination.
Thank you.
Ah... Honey...
Could we just... pass on the prize presentation?
Hm?
Weren't you bugging me about wanting an "MVP-exclusive award" all night long? Why the sudden...
NO! Honey, I, er, I think...
"The real prize is the friends we made along the way!"
Yeah! That's it!
There's no winners or losers in Lycan Sanctuary, especially not the Werewolves! They definitely don't need to win!
What matters is that everyone has fun and everything is peaceful, ahahahaha, hahahaha...
Pathetic laughter echoes around the nearby stalls.
The Dolls exchange glances, and hide their smug smiles.
Clink—
Four glasses of champagne make contact with each other, and the mood in the air is as light and upbeat as the fizziness in the liquid.
To victory!
Everyone, thanks for your hard work.
And you especially, Miss Gr G36; I have to hand it to you for coming up with such a brilliant way to deal with K-PDW.
Not at all. It was all because of everyone's cooperation and acting skills.
We didn't do much compared to how you loaded those horror scenes into K-PDW's neural cloud, Miss Gr G36~
Oh yes, did you get rid of the back door and access logs?
Don't worry, I took care of it.
People come and go between the stalls, and the air is lively and warm.
The gentle lights reflect in Gr G36, and her mouth curls up in a faint smile.
Lycan Sanctuary [END]
